evidence: Reviewed by an agent from source, against 574875b6 (b6f55d69 after PR 1122 on release 305dfaa4) through the driver-model cutover. For the app: GET /api/drivers and its icon route are new, backend cards add optional fields, and Hermes is no longer a built-in backend, so cards drop it and a stored hermes key reads back unchanged. Old builds keep working: they decode every field they require (card, configuration, ticket and settings changes only add fields), find a backend through an optional lookup, never read tool_kind, and call no removed route. A send on a stored Hermes conversation gets the existing 400 unknown agent backend shape, which old builds show as a failed send. Schema step 1, supervision, install recovery and the executor removals change no response the app reads. Native iOS CI (simulator build and host tests) passed on driver-model, run 44209036980, and PR 1124 had a Mac simulator review. No signed-device test ran. The staging merge of 1620d020..66841026 changes nothing the app reads: the app calls no update route, the update-failure push reuses the stall alarm's payload with route /#/, and b702c46c keeps the model list and card shapes. An independent review of PRs 1142 and 1145 (Antigravity on a shared ACP layer, Hermes removal, follow-ups) found no response shape changed: backend_key and the window kind still decode as strings, Antigravity's family labels reach the phone as modelId, the new 422 and 503 sign-in responses sit on routes the app does not call, and removing Hermes changes nothing the app decodes. Step 1 now also creates navigation_view_ordered, which the server used to create for itself at startup, and the seed holds it; no response shape changes, because the table already existed on every used database and the navigation reads over it are unchanged. PR 1149 (release build writes the two retired Hermes files as empty files, in build.ts and mac_home_build.ts, plus retired_driver_files.ts) changes only how the release archive is built; it adds no route and changes no response the app reads. PR 1151 restores the two Hermes Python scripts outside server/ and changes nothing the app reads. Ticket t_wms940t7 (schema step ts_0002_project_repository, Project repository_url and default_branch fields, StartRun.workspace_repository, and unified workspace cloning) adds only nullable fields on /api/projects?detail=full and POST/PATCH /api/projects (IdeaProject decodes id and name and ignores extra keys, GoalAPI reads dynamic GoalJSON, and ViewProjectValue decodes name); start-values responses and navigation records keep their exact shapes, and executor wire additions stay server-to-executor only. Ticket t_z4qg9xkc (schema step ts_0003_ticket_worker_setups, a Worker setup record, the executor POST /api/executor/workspaces/setup route and WorkerSetupReport wire root) adds only optional data the app may read: agent_state can now be the string setting_up, which existing builds decode as a String and treat as neither working nor errored; /api/tickets rows and navigation Ticket records gain an optional worker_setup object that ViewTicketValue and the ticket models ignore in old builds because they decode only the keys they declare; restart-worker can now return the existing validation error shape with a new message. No route the app calls is removed and no required field changes. This build's app groups setting_up with active Workers and reads worker_setup from navigation records. No simulator or device build ran for this change. Since 461575df: PR 1168 changes only the Claude permission mode the server starts agents with; no route or response changes. PR 1169 adds an optional attachments key to the Ticket decision command and stores attachments with the decision for the Worker prompt; old app builds send decisions without it and the reply shape is unchanged. PR 1167 (review deck motion) is web only. No other server route or response the app reads changes. Ticket t_7egqu03v removes Ideas: GET and POST /api/ideas are gone and schema step ts_0004_drop_ideas drops the ideas table. Installed builds that open More > Ideas get the existing 404 error shape, which they show as a failed read on that one screen; every other route and response the app reads is unchanged, and this build's app no longer has an Ideas screen. No simulator or device build ran for this change. One version answer for clients adds optional /api/meta compatibility and installed-release fields, a diagnostic client_versions schema step, and a common client header. Old iPhone builds still send X-Panels-iOS-Build and receive the same minimum-build1 policy and ios_update_required response. The common header is additive and not an authorization credential. New native requests keep the legacy build header. No native response field is removed. Fastify compatibility and headerless transition cases pass; hosted Native iOS verification is recorded with the Ticket implementation evidence. No signed-device check ran for this Ticket. Ticket t_jctb8ndx adds an optional operation_id key to the permission-answers and user-input-answers request bodies, an optional operation_id on the stored permission_answered and user_input_answered notebook rows, and a new route GET /api/conversation/conversations/:id/answer-receipts/:operation_id. No existing route, request or response changes shape: an old build sends no operation_id and gets the same { fate } reply. A repeat answer that carried an ID now returns the saved fate where it returned refused, and the same ID with different content returns 422. No simulator or device build ran for this change. The merge of staging into feature/iphone-rebuild combines both trails above; neither side changes a route or response the other reads, and this build's app has no Ideas screen.
